title: 第20章 灯光师针对
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 林深云一屁股坐在沙发上，声音沉得像压了块石头：“学校那个项目，黄了。”林念薇愣住：“什么？怎么会黄了？不是说得好好的吗？”话音刚落，林深云的手机响了。是助理打来的。“林总，工地材料那事儿查清楚了……是赵大彪干的。”“他觉得自已帮您办了事，压了温屿的赔偿款，有您撑腰，胆子就大了，私下换了劣质材料，吃回扣。”林深云握着手机的手微微发抖。挂了电话，他脸色发白。这会真是搬起石头砸自已的脚了！他想用温屿急需的医药费逼温栩栩回来，结果不仅没成，还把林家的地产大项目搞黄了。林念薇在旁边听得清清楚楚，脸上的表情从震惊变成了慌张：“爸……那、那咱们要赔多少钱？我的零花钱……不会受影响吧？”林深云没说话。林念薇更慌了，转头看向林母。林母拍了拍她的手，示意她别急，然后走过去坐到林深云身边：“行了行了，一个项目而已，咱们林家底子厚，赔点钱就赔点钱。”林念薇一听“赔钱”两个字，心里咯噔一下。她下个月还想买那个限量包呢。林母瞥了她一眼，知道她在想什么，冷笑一声：“急什么？项目黄了，又不是咱们林家倒了。”她语气里带上几分不屑：“再说了，那个丫头真以为广告代言是那么好拍的？”“随便什么人都能上？镜头这东西，气质是需要长期培养的，咱们念薇从小练到大，那是实打实的功底。”林念薇听到这儿，眼睛忽然亮了。对呀！温栩栩抢了她的代言又怎么样？拍广告可不是光皮肤白就行，镜头感、气质、表现力。这些东西，她可是从小练到大的。她靠在沙发上，嘴角慢慢勾起一抹幸灾乐祸的笑：“妈说得对。等拍摄的时候，她往镜头前一站，呆得跟个木头人似的，品牌方当场就能悔得肠子都青了。”林母冷笑一声：“到时候，看她还有什么脸蹦跶。”林念薇忽然想起什么，眼睛更亮了：“对了妈，我听说这次拍广告的导演是季川，就是那个拍谁红谁、但脾气也大得出了名的季川。”她语气里满是期待：“上次有个小明星被他骂哭的视频，热搜挂了一整天。温栩栩那种没受过专业训练的，往他镜头前一站，怕不是要被骂到怀疑人生。”林母也笑了：“那正好。让她见识见识，什么叫专业。”林念薇靠在沙发上，越想越期待，恨不得那天的拍摄现在就发生。她要亲眼看着温栩栩在镜头前手足无措、季川摔本子骂人、品牌方脸黑如锅底的样子。那画面，一定比什么限量包都好看。周六早上。温栩栩一身简约的小香风外套，踩着低跟短靴，推开了摄影棚的门。她是第一次进这种地方。灯光、轨道、反光板、一堆叫不出名字的设备密密麻麻挤在棚里，工作人员走来走去，每个人脸上都写着“我很忙”。温栩栩深吸一口气，心跳快了一拍。紧张吗？有一点。不过，没有模特基础的她也不是特别虚。因为她有世界上最牛的指导老师！！自从接了代言，嫦娥姐姐就主动揽下了“仪态私教”的活儿。每天晚上，温栩栩对着手机摄像头摆姿势，嫦娥在屏幕那头点评：“下巴低一点……对，眼神往左前方看，不要飘……”“笑的时候嘴角先往上提，再慢慢松开——你这样太急了，像要咬人。”“转身的时候肩膀先动，头最后转，要有余韵……”温栩栩当时还想：不就是凹个造型吗，至于这么讲究？嫦娥只回了一句：“丫头，你见过哪个仙子是急吼吼转头的？”温栩栩：……行吧，您说得对。现在她站在摄影棚门口，想起这几天的魔鬼训练，忽然觉得——有谁能比天上的仙子更懂什么叫“仪态”？底气一下子就上来了。温栩栩抬脚往里走。路过的人，目光不自觉地往她身上飘。一个扛着反光板的场务愣了两秒，差点撞上旁边的灯架。“不好意思不好意思——”他道歉完，又忍不住回头看了一眼。化妆间的门半开着，几个工作人员凑在一起小声嘀咕：“哇塞，那个就是新来的代言人？皮肤真的好好啊……”“我听说封总亲自签的，从素人里挖出来的，之前没进过圈。”“素人？这气质不像啊，你看她走路那感觉……我以为哪个公司新签的艺人呢。”“难怪封总能看上，这底子，比圈里不少人都能打。”温栩栩听着这些话飘进耳朵，面上不显，心里默默给嫦娥点了个赞。嫦娥姐姐，您这一周的教学，效果拔群。正想着，一个化妆师拎着箱子小跑过来，看见她的第一眼，脚步就顿住了。“……我去。”化妆师盯着她的脸，眼睛慢慢睁大，围着她转了一圈，又转了一圈。然后她伸手，轻轻戳了戳温栩栩的脸颊，像在验证什么。“你这是素颜？”温栩栩点头。化妆师倒吸一口凉气：“底妆不用打了。粉底、遮瑕、隔离——全都不用。你这皮肤，上粉底反而是糟蹋。”她顿了顿，语气里带着一种专业人士的震撼：“我就给你描个眉毛，最多再加点眼影……你这脸，放娱乐圈能打一片。”温栩栩被她说得有点不好意思，笑了笑没接话。化妆师已经开始翻工具包，嘴里还在念叨：“你等着，我给你画完，今天全场都得问你用的什么粉底——”旁边，一个正在调试灯光的男人，手里的动作微微顿了顿。他抬起头，目光从灯光设备上移开，落在温栩栩身上。眼神闪了闪。然后又低下头，继续调灯。只是嘴角，微微往下压了一点。温栩栩化好妆，被工作人员领进拍摄区。摄影棚正中，一个高大的男人正低头调试相机。白衬衫，袖子随意挽到手肘，露出一截线条利落的小臂。头发是顺毛，微微有些长，遮住一点眉眼，整个人透着一种“别来烦我”的疏离感。这人便是季川。业内公认的顶级广告摄影师，传闻脾气古怪，但在圈内，季川的名字就是金字招牌——他手里的镜头，能把人的美貌放大到极致。季川抬起头，目光落在温栩栩身上。视线在她脸上多停留了半秒，然后移开，继续低头摆弄相机。他只是淡淡开口：“站过去吧。先试拍几张，找找感觉。”温栩栩走到指定位置，深吸一口气。灯光亮起。一开始还好，她按着嫦娥教的那些技巧，调整角度、眼神、微表情。但很快，温栩栩发现不太对劲。那灯光——怎么老往她眼睛上怼？明明刚才站位的时候还好，现在却像长了眼睛似的，追着她的眼球照。她微微偏头，光也跟着偏；她垂下眼，光又抬高一点，正好刺进瞳孔。温栩栩眨了眨眼，视线开始模糊。
content_en: Lin Shenyun sat down on the sofa, and his voice was as heavy as a stone: "That school project is obscene." Lin Nianwei was stunned: "What? How could it be obscene? Isn't that a good thing?" As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Shenyun's cell phone rang.It's the assistant calling."Mr. Lin, we have found out about the construction site materials...it was Zhao Dabiao who did it." "He felt that he had done something for you and suppressed Wen Yu's compensation. With your support, he was bolder and secretly replaced inferior materials with kickbacks." Lin Shenyun's hand holding the phone was shaking slightly.After hanging up the phone, his face turned pale.This would really be like shooting yourself in the foot!He wanted to use Wen Yu's urgently needed medical expenses to force Wen Xuxu back. Not only did he fail, but he also ruined the Lin family's big real estate project.Lin Nianwei heard clearly from the side, and the expression on her face changed from shock to panic: "Dad...then, how much do we have to pay? My pocket money...will not be affected, right?" Lin Shenyun said nothing.Lin Nianwei became even more panicked and turned to look at Mother Lin.Lin's mother clapped her hand and told her not to worry, then walked over and sat next to Lin Shenyun: "Okay, okay, it's just a project. Our Lin family has a strong foundation, so if you lose some money, just pay some money." When Lin Nianwei heard the word "compensate", her heart skipped a beat.She still wants to buy that limited edition bag next month.Mother Lin glanced at her, knowing what she was thinking, and sneered: "Why are you anxious? The project failed, and it's not our Lin family that failed." There was a bit of disdain in her tone: "Besides, that girl really thinks that advertising endorsements are so easy to photograph?" "Anyone can be on the camera? Temperament requires long-term cultivation of the camera. Our Nianwei has practiced it since childhood, and it is a solid foundation." When Lin Nianwei heard this, her eyes suddenly lit up.Yes!So what if Wen Xuxu stole her endorsement?Shooting an advertisement is not just about having fair skin, but also about camera sense, temperament, and expressiveness.She has been practicing these things since she was a child.She leaned on the sofa, and a gloating smile slowly appeared at the corner of her mouth: "Mom is right. During the filming, she stood in front of the camera, dumbfounded, and the brand owner was so regretful that her intestines turned green." Mother Lin sneered, "Let's see how upbeat she is then." Lin Nianwei suddenly remembered something, and her eyes brightened: "By the way, Mom, I heard that the director of this commercial is Ji Chuan, the one who shoots whoever is famous., but Ji Chuan is also famous for his temper." Her tone was filled with anticipation: "Last time, there was a video of a little star being scolded by him, which was trending all day long.If someone like Wen Xuxu stood in front of his camera, he would be scolded and doubt his life." Mother Lin also smiled: "That's good.Let her see what it means to be professional." Lin Nianwei leaned on the sofa, the more she thought about it, the more she wished that the shooting would happen now.She wanted to see with her own eyes Wen Xuxu was at a loss in front of the camera, Ji Chuan threw his book and cursed, and Brand Fang's face was as dark as the bottom of a pot.That picture must be more beautiful than any limited edition package.Saturday morning.Wen Xuxu was wearing a simple fragrant jacket and low-heeled short boots, and opened the door of the studio.This was her first time in such a place.Lights, tracks, reflectors, and a bunch of unnamed equipment were crowded in the shed, and staff were walking around, with "I'm busy" written on everyone's face.Wen Xuxu took a deep breath and her heart beat a beat faster.Nervous?A little bit.However, she is not particularly weak since she has no modeling background.Because she has the most awesome instructor in the world!!Since accepting the endorsement, sister Chang'e has taken the initiative to take on the job of "personal trainer of manners".Every night, Wen Xuxu posed in front of the mobile phone camera, and Chang'e commented on the other side of the screen: "Lower your chin... yes, look to the left and front, don't drift..." "When you smile, lift the corners of your mouth first, and then slowly release it - you are too hasty, as if you want to bite someone." "When you turn around, move your shoulders first, and turn your head last. There must be a lingering effect..." Wen Xuxu also thought at the time: Isn't it just a concave shape? As for being so particular?Chang'e only replied: "Girl, have you ever seen any fairy who turned around in a hurry?" Wen Xuxu: ...Okay, you are right.Now she was standing at the door of the studio, thinking of the devil's training these days, and suddenly felt - who can know what "manners" is better than the fairy in the sky?The confidence suddenly came up.Wen Xuxu raised his feet and walked inside.People passing by looked at her unconsciously.A field attendant carrying a reflector was stunned for two seconds and almost hit the light stand next to him."Sorry, sorry--" After he apologized, he couldn't help but look back.The door of the dressing room was half open, and several staff members gathered together and whispered: "Wow, is that the new spokesperson? Her skin is really good..." "I heard that Mr. Feng signed it himself, and dug it out from amateurs. I have never been in the industry before." "Amateur? This is so angry.She doesn't have the same qualities. Look at her walking style... I thought she was a newly signed artist from some company."No wonder Mr. Feng likes her. With her skills, she is better than many people in the industry."Wen Xuxu listened to these words and gave Chang'e a silent thumbs up.Sister Chang'e, your teaching this week has been outstanding.Just as she was thinking about it, a makeup artist trotted over carrying a box. When he saw her for the first time, he stopped in his tracks."...I'll go." The makeup artist stared at her face, his eyes slowly widened, and he circled around her, then circled her again.Then she reached out and gently poked Wen Xuxu's cheek, as if to verify something."Are you wearing no makeup?" Wen Xuxu nodded.The makeup artist took a breath: "You don't need to put on base makeup. Foundation, concealer, isolation - none of them. With your skin, foundation will be a waste." She paused, with a professional shock in her voice: "I'll just draw your eyebrows and add some eye shadow at most... Your face can make you famous in the entertainment industry." Wen Xuxu was a little embarrassed by what she said, so she smiled and didn't answer.The makeup artist had already begun to look through the tool bag, and was still mumbling: "Just wait, I'll finish painting it for you, and everyone in the audience will ask you what foundation you used today -" Next to him, a man who was adjusting the lighting paused slightly.He raised his head, looked away from the lighting equipment, and landed on Wen Xuxu.His eyes flickered.Then he lowered his head and continued to adjust the lights.Just the corners of his mouth were slightly depressed.Wen Xuxu put on makeup and was led into the shooting area by the staff.In the middle of the studio, a tall man was lowering his head to adjust the camera.A white shirt with sleeves rolled up casually to the elbow, revealing a neat forearm.The hair is smooth and slightly long, covering a little of the eyebrows. The whole person exudes a sense of "don't bother me" and alienation.This person is Ji Chuan.He is recognized as the top advertising photographer in the industry and is rumored to have an eccentric temper. However, in the circle, Ji Chuan's name is a golden sign - the lens in his hand can magnify people's beauty to the extreme.Ji Chuan raised his head and his eyes fell on Wen Xuxu.His eyes stayed on her face for half a second, then moved away and continued to lower his head and fiddle with the camera.He just said calmly: "Stand over. Take a few test shots first and get a feel for it." Wen Xuxu walked to the designated location and took a deep breath.The lights come on.It was okay at first. She followed the techniques taught by Chang'e and adjusted her angle, eyes, and micro-expressions.But soon, Wen Xuxu realized something was wrong.That light—why is it always shining on her eyes?It was obviously fine when he was standing just now, but now he seems to have eyes, chasing after her eyeballs.She tilted her head slightly, and the light followed suit; she lowered her eyes, and the light raised a little higher, just piercing her pupils.Wen Xuxu blinked and his vision began to blur.
